anchors.label: Supreme Court: Washington city context
anchors.precision_label: City centroid; public institution city context, not a building or event location
anchors.geography_assertion: The Court lists Washington, DC as its institutional city. The point represents Washington city, not the Supreme Court building, a participant’s presence, or the place where a particular judicial act occurred.
anchors.city_qualification: The Court’s nationwide authority is not represented by the Washington city boundary.

geography.name: Washington city
geography.boundary_use: Display context only. No claim these are historical boundaries on the procedural event date or legally definitive jurisdictional limits.

coordinates.method_detail: Signed, translated shoelace formula over every ArcGIS polygon ring in the returned EPSG:4326 longitude/latitude plane. Holes subtract by orientation. This is a reproducible visual centroid, not a geodesic center, land-only center, population center or official Census CENTLAT/CENTLON. No address was geocoded.
coordinates.uncertainty_note: The point is a representative display location for the whole named geographic unit; no metric positional-accuracy claim is made. Decimal count is numerical storage precision, not source accuracy.

source_published_centroid_not_used.reason: Attribute datum is not expressly stated by the layer fields. Map coordinates instead derive from explicitly returned EPSG:4326 geometry.

coverage_note: New acquisition was bounded to official institutional location/procedural passages and three official Census geography records. The full NYDFS PDF was transiently downloaded to extract its first-page institutional caption only; its remaining pages were not substantively read or retained by this pass. No email release corpus, archive, image/video release, software or model was acquired. Geodata is approximately 1.3 MB of JSON. Search snippets were discovery only.
limitations: Source extraction and tests do not substitute for independent source review.
Census 2020 polygons are visual context, not a current legal-jurisdiction adjudication.
A centroid can be outside land or outside the institution’s actual premises.
The present institutional city page does not prove where any historical procedural event occurred.
The broad state/territory roles do not establish where a company acted, money moved or a person was present.

public_projection.scope: Metadata-only packaging projection of the historical locally reviewed candidate. This is not a new source review or geography approval.
